text: Most health AI waits for the patient to remember what to ask. HealthIA ONE does the opposite. In the promoted Google Cloud runtime, an opted-in blood-pressure follow-up becomes durable work without another prompt: Firestore commits the mission, Eventarc wakes a private worker, Gmail reaches the patient, Pub/Sub returns the reply, a VitalRecord is written, and the same mission closes. The trigger uses zero model calls.

Now the deeper Guardian idea, on a separate research build running real Guardian code. Ana is synthetic. Her Twin knows Losartan fifty milligrams daily is active and patient-confirmed. Proactive continuity and patient-email auto-send are authorized. Ana typed nothing.

A renal result arrives. Because Losartan is registered, Guardian checks whether the record contains renal-function and potassium evidence. Creatinine is present; potassium is not. With zero chat prompts, HealthIA opens a durable treatment-aware mission and prepares a patient-only notification. It does not diagnose kidney disease or change medication.
Later potassium arrives. Guardian links it to the open mission, attaches durable evidence and a receipt, and closes only because the missing evidence now exists. Treatment remains unchanged.

A family-medicine visit is thirty-six hours away. HealthIA checks requirements against the Twin: recent results verified, medication list verified, insurance missing. Guardian opens a preparation mission for exactly what is missing, not a generic reminder.
Insurance arrives. HealthIA rechecks the requirements, attaches the evidence, and closes the same mission. It does not book, cancel, or alter the appointment.
The visit is later marked completed, but no consultation or discharge note exists. Post-Visit Guardian opens a continuity mission and refuses to invent the outcome.
When the consultation note arrives, Guardian links it to the completed visit and closes from durable evidence. Three missions, all created from longitudinal state, not three chat prompts.

When the patient does want guidance, the live product uses Gemini 3.5 Flash through Google ADK to build an adaptive clinical interview from the current complaint and authorized context. Deterministic safety prevents orientation from becoming autonomous diagnosis or prescribing.

ONE SAFETY keeps autonomy honest. A protected real-world action crosses deterministic authorization, a one-use HealthActionTicket, the connector, a durable receipt, and Google Cloud Trace. Authorization is not completion. The outside world must leave evidence.

HealthIA ONE is not a search box or an autonomous doctor. It is a patient-owned continuity agent: watching the authorized Twin, finding unfinished work, verifying evidence, contacting the patient when allowed, and stopping where human authority begins. Your health never starts over. Neither should your health agent.
